plans.close_all: Only trigger a full close if an extreme systemic market event threatens overall portfolio structure; otherwise rely on individual layer limits.
plans.hostage_policy: Apply TSM's Hostage Hunt Strategy (Mindset #3: Wait & See). If an army (layer) enters Negative NAV, hold the position patiently as long as it remains within its 50% adverse excursion limit ($2,500 collateral / $5,000 notional). Deploy remaining available armies into high-probability Zero Alpha setups on other watchlist symbols to capture volatility buffers (+chely) and use those accumulated profits to offset and release the trapped layer.
plans.rationale: We are initializing the portfolio with 4 armies of $2,500 collateral each. Setting notional to $5,000 establishes a conservative 2x leverage per layer (well below the 10x-40x max leverage limits), giving each army a 50% price excursion stop-loss cushion. This low-stress Risk Parameter (RP) ensures our armies are very hard to kill, allowing us to dynamically flow with market volatility. Majors (BTC, ETH, SOL) are trading below last week's VWAP in a bearish-to-ranging regime, while ZEC and ENA show relative strength holding above their 50-day EMAs, offering a balanced mix of directional and mean-reversion battlefields.
